name: raysman-claude
description: Claude Code plugins for the raysman-claude workspace, including gstack enforcement, skill-routing guidance, and video frame analysis.

plugins.name: gstack-guard
plugins.description: Blocks skill usage until gstack is installed globally, and ships gstack setup + skill-routing guidance as a skill.

plugins.name: video-vision
plugins.description: Analyze videos by sampling frames with ffmpeg so Claude can read them as images and reason about the contents.
